domain: Motion and Stability: Forces and Interactions

items.prompt:
Magnets can be used to
A) solve real problems like holding a door closed
B) do nothing useful
C) only make noise
D) only make light
items.answer: A) solve real problems like holding a door closed

steps: Magnets can hold, sort, and latch things.

items.prompt:
A magnet will NOT hold a door closed if the door is made of
A) steel
B) iron

D) a magnetic metal

Two magnet latches are tested; one holds the lid and one does not. The better design is the one that

items.prompt:
The BEST reason magnets can sort steel from plastic is that magnets
A) attract steel but not plastic
B) attract plastic but not steel
C) attract everything
D) attract nothing
items.answer: A) attract steel but not plastic

steps: Only the steel is pulled, so the magnet separates them.
